name: Rakesh Banda
professional_summary: Systems-focused AI Engineer specializing in the architecture of autonomous agents and high-performance RAG pipelines. Expert in designing multi-modal 'action-perception' loops for browser automation and optimizing LLM inference via structured data protocols (YAML/JSON). Proven ability to bridge the gap between raw model capabilities and production-grade tool-use.

projects.name: Autonomous Browser Agent: Visual Grounding & DOM Manipulation
details: Engineered a closed-loop browser agent capable of navigating dynamic web environments using GPT-5 Vision and Playwright/CDP.
Implemented a custom 'Set-of-Mark' labeling system to map visual coordinates to DOM elements, enabling 95%+ accuracy in form-filling and UI interaction.
Developed a high-efficiency data pipeline using YAML for input prompting to reduce token overhead by 20% while maintaining strict JSON schemas for tool-calling outputs.
Utilized LangGraph to manage complex, multi-step agentic states, allowing the agent to recover from UI failures (pop-ups, slow-loading AJAX) without human intervention.
Achieved a 30% reduction in action latency by implementing parallel test-time compute strategies, allowing the agent to 'reason' about page layouts before execution.

projects.name: AI Knowledge Assistant & Resume Parsing Engine
details: Designed and deployed an 'AI Knowledge Assistant' utilizing semantic search and vector embeddings (Pinecone/Weaviate) to query massive technical document collections.
Built an end-to-end resume parsing engine that transformed unstructured PDF data into structured YAML, streamlining ingestion for downstream LLM processing.
Improved response reliability by grounding LLM responses with retrieved context, reducing hallucination risk.
Technical Stack: Python, SQL, PyTorch, LangChain, and LaTeX for technical documentation.

certifications: Fundamentals of AI Agents – Hugging Face
Agile Methodology Virtual Experience Program – Cognizant (Sprint Planning, Jira workflows)

education.degree: Master of Science in Computer Science
